channel.title: Notification Settings on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Notification Settings on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Silence Policy
item.description: This section describes how to create a silence policy. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.

item.title: Edit Muting Policy Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit muting policy information. You can edit the alias and description of a muting policy. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a created muting policy. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.

item.title: Edit Silence Conditions
item.description: This section describes how to edit notification silence conditions. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.

item.title: Edit Mute Duration
item.description: This section describes how to edit notification mute duration. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. The KubeSphere platform needs to have the WizTelemetry Notification extension installed and enabled. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.

item.title: Delete a Silence Policy
item.description: This section describes how to delete a silence policy. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Delete a Single Silence Policy Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.

item.title: Modify Notification Language
item.description: This section describes how to modify the notification language. Notifications sent to users contain key-value pair information. You can set the language for the keys in the notifications. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.
